articles.summary: ESS Tech, Inc. (NYSE: GWH) ("ESS" or the "Company"), a leading manufacturer of long-duration iron flow energy storage systems (“LDES”) for commercial and utility-scale applications, highlighted the findings of a final report issued in connection with Burbank Water and Power for the American Public Power Association (APPA) to evaluate the application of ESS’ Iron Flow Battery technology in a real-world utility environment.
articles.title: ESS Highlights Third-Party Utility Validating Iron Flow Battery Technology
ESS Partners with Alsym Energy to Deliver 8.5 GWh of Non-Lithium Battery Energy Storage Solutions
